destination_translations.headline: Zócalos y agua entre montañas
destination_translations.intro: Un pueblo de fachadas coloridas a orillas del embalse Peñol–Guatapé.
destination_translations.meta_description: Un pueblo de fachadas coloridas a orillas del embalse Peñol–Guatapé.

destination_translations.headline: Colourful façades and mountain waters
destination_translations.intro: A colourful town beside the Peñol–Guatapé reservoir.
destination_translations.meta_description: A colourful town beside the Peñol–Guatapé reservoir.

destination_translations.headline: Fachadas coloridas e águas entre montanhas
destination_translations.intro: Um povoado colorido às margens da represa Peñol–Guatapé.
destination_translations.meta_description: Um povoado colorido às margens da represa Peñol–Guatapé.

destination_story_translations.body: Los zócalos forman parte de la identidad local desde comienzos del siglo XX. La creación del embalse transformó el paisaje y fortaleció la actividad turística.
Decorative zócalos have shaped local identity since the early twentieth century. The reservoir transformed the landscape and encouraged tourism.
Os zócalos fazem parte da identidade local desde o início do século XX. A criação da represa transformou a paisagem e fortaleceu o turismo.

destination_reason_translations.body: Relieves de colores, el Peñón y navegación por el embalse.
Colourful reliefs, the Rock and reservoir boat trips.
Relevos coloridos, a Pedra e passeios pela represa.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Piedra del Peñol (Peñón de Guatapé)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Asciende la escalinata y contempla los brazos del embalse.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Piedra del Peñol (Guatapé Rock)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Climb the stairway for views over the reservoir.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Pedra do Peñol (Pedra de Guatapé)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Suba a escadaria para observar os braços da represa.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Plazoleta de los Zócalos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Relieves de colores cuentan historias y oficios del pueblo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Zócalos Square
point_of_interest_translations.description: Colourful reliefs tell stories of local life and trades.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Praça dos Zócalos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Relevos coloridos contam histórias e ofícios locais.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Calle de las Sombrillas
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un corredor de sombrillas de colores y fachadas con zócalos.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Umbrella Street
point_of_interest_translations.description: A passage beneath colourful umbrellas and decorated façades.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Rua dos Guarda-Chuvas
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um corredor de guarda-chuvas coloridos e fachadas com zócalos.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Malecón de Guatapé
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un paseo junto al embalse y los embarcaderos del pueblo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Guatapé Waterfront
point_of_interest_translations.description: A promenade beside the reservoir and town piers.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Orla de Guatapé
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um passeio à beira da represa e dos embarcadouros.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque principal
point_of_interest_translations.description: La iglesia y las fachadas tradicionales rodean el corazón del pueblo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Main Square
point_of_interest_translations.description: The church and traditional façades frame the town centre.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Praça principal
point_of_interest_translations.description: A igreja e as fachadas tradicionais cercam o centro do povoado.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Paseo en barco por el embalse
point_of_interest_translations.description: Navega entre penínsulas e islas del paisaje Peñol–Guatapé.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Reservoir boat tour
point_of_interest_translations.description: Cruise among the peninsulas and islands of Peñol–Guatapé.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio de barco pela represa
point_of_interest_translations.description: Navegue entre penínsulas e ilhas de Peñol–Guatapé.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Jet ski en el embalse
point_of_interest_translations.description: Recorre el agua en moto acuática tras la inducción de manejo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Reservoir jet skiing
point_of_interest_translations.description: Ride a personal watercraft after a handling briefing.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Jet ski na represa
point_of_interest_translations.description: Navegue de moto aquática após as orientações de condução.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Tour en kayak

point_of_interest_translations.name: Guided kayak tour
point_of_interest_translations.description: Paddle along the reservoir shores with a guide.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio guiado de caiaque
point_of_interest_translations.description: Reme pelas margens da represa com um guia.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Esquí acuático
point_of_interest_translations.description: Deslízate sobre esquís remolcados por una lancha con instructor.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Water skiing
point_of_interest_translations.description: Glide on skis towed by a boat with an instructor.

point_of_interest_translations.description: Practica equilibrio sobre la tabla con acompañamiento de instructor.
